docs.title: HelloHost Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to HelloHost - the complete subscription management platform for your business.

HelloHost helps you manage clients, automate billing, handle domains and hosting, track support tickets, and grow your business efficiently.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
New to HelloHost? Start here:

  1. Getting Started - Create your account and complete initial setup
  2. Configuration - Configure your settings, branding, and integrations
  3. Connectors - Connect payment processors, domain registrars, and hosting servers (optional)

docs.title: What You Can Do With HelloHost
Manage Clients
docs.text:
• Store complete client information and billing details
  • Organize clients with labels and categories
  • Give clients access to a branded portal
  • Securely share passwords and important information
  • Track all interactions with activity logs

docs.title: Automate Billing
docs.text:
• Create recurring subscriptions that bill automatically
  • Generate professional PDF invoices with your branding
  • Accept online payments with multiple payment methods
  • Send automatic payment reminders
  • Support multiple currencies and languages

docs.title: Handle Hosting & Domains
docs.text:
• Connect to domain registrars (OXXA, Versio)
  • Automatically register and manage domains
  • Edit DNS zones directly from HelloHost
  • Connect hosting servers (cPanel, DirectAdmin)
  • Automatically provision hosting accounts

docs.title: Track Support & Tasks
docs.text:
• Manage support tickets from clients
  • Assign tasks to team members
  • Set priorities and due dates
  • Track time spent on billable work
  • Convert tasks directly to invoice items

docs.title: Monitor Your Business
docs.text:
• Track revenue and forecast future income
  • Monitor expenses and profitability
  • View payment history and reports
  • Track website performance for clients
  • See all activity in one dashboard

docs.title: Team Collaboration
docs.text:
• Add team members with custom permissions
  • Control who can access financial data
  • Assign tasks and track completion
  • Review work before it's sent to clients

docs.title: Learn More
docs.text:
• Features - Complete list of all HelloHost features
  • How It Works - Learn about HelloHost's platform and capabilities
  • Configuration - Detailed setup and configuration guide
  • Connectors - Third-party integrations and connections

docs.title: Get Started Today
docs.text:
Ready to streamline your business? Create your HelloHost account and start your free trial today.

Need help? Contact our support team or browse this documentation for answers to common questions.

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text: HelloHost is a modern, cloud-based subscription management platform designed to simplify your business operations.

docs.title: Platform Overview
docs.text: HelloHost provides a complete solution for managing your subscription business, from client relationships to billing and technical infrastructure. The platform is designed to be intuitive, powerful, and scalable.

docs.title: Complete Data Isolation
docs.text:
Each HelloHost organization operates in its own completely isolated environment. This means:

  • Your data is private - No other organizations can access your information
  • Custom branding - Each organization can have its own logo, colors, and domain
  • Independent settings - Configure the platform to match your business needs
  • Secure by design - Industry-standard security measures protect your data

docs.title: Multi-Language Support
docs.text:
HelloHost speaks your language! The platform supports:

  • English
  • German
  • Dutch
  • Ukrainian

Both you and your clients can use the platform in their preferred language, with all invoices, emails, and interface elements automatically translated.

docs.title: Client Portal
docs.text:
Your clients get access to a dedicated portal where they can:

  • View and pay invoices
  • Manage their subscriptions and services
  • Submit support tickets
  • Update their account information
  • Access important documents and passwords you've shared with them

The portal is automatically branded with your company logo and colors, providing a seamless experience.

docs.title: Automated Communication
docs.text:
Clients receive professional, branded emails for:

  • New invoices with direct payment links
  • Payment confirmations
  • Service renewal reminders
  • Support ticket updates
  • Important account notifications

All communication happens automatically, saving you time while keeping clients informed.

docs.title: Client Management
docs.text:
• Store complete client information including billing details and contacts
  • Organize clients with custom labels and categories
  • Track all interactions and changes with activity logs
  • Securely share passwords and access credentials
  • Manage multiple users per client account

docs.title: Service Catalog
docs.text:
Create your own service catalog including:

  • Domain registration services
  • Hosting packages
  • SSL certificates
  • Email hosting
  • Custom services (design, support, consulting, etc.)

Each service can have flexible pricing, billing cycles, and automated provisioning.

docs.title: Subscription Management
docs.text:
• Automatic recurring billing for subscriptions
  • Flexible billing cycles (monthly, quarterly, yearly, custom)
  • Auto-renewal or manual renewal options
  • Client notifications before renewals
  • Easy cancellation workflow

docs.title: Financial Management
docs.text:
Invoicing: * Automatic invoice generation from subscriptions * Manual invoice creation for one-time services * Professional PDF invoices with your branding * Multi-currency support * EU VAT compliance

Payments: * Online payment acceptance via Mollie * Support for credit cards, iDEAL, SEPA, PayPal, and more * Automated payment collection with direct debit * Payment reminders for overdue invoices * Refund processing

Financial Tracking: * Revenue statistics and forecasting * Expense tracking and profitability analysis * Payment history and reporting

docs.title: Task & Ticket Management
docs.text:
• Support ticket system for client requests
  • Internal task management for your team
  • Recurring tasks for regular maintenance
  • Task assignment and review workflows
  • Time tracking for billable work
  • Convert tasks directly to invoice items

docs.title: Technical Integration
docs.text:
Domain Management: * Connect to domain registrars (OXXA, Versio) * Automatic domain registration * DNS zone management * Domain transfer handling * Auto-renewal management

Hosting Automation: * Connect to cPanel or DirectAdmin servers * Automatic hosting account creation * Account suspension and deletion * Integration with subscriptions

Performance Monitoring: * Track website performance with Google Lighthouse * Monitor client websites over time * Identify and resolve performance issues

docs.title: Security & Privacy
docs.text:
Your security is our priority:

  • Two-Factor Authentication - Optional 2FA for enhanced account security
  • Role-Based Permissions - Control what each team member can access
  • Activity Logging - Complete audit trail of all actions
  • Encrypted Data - Sensitive information is encrypted
  • Secure Payments - PCI-compliant payment processing
  • Regular Backups - Your data is backed up regularly

docs.title: Scalability
docs.text:
HelloHost grows with your business:

  • No limits on clients, subscriptions, or invoices
  • Support for multiple team members with different permissions
  • Handles high volumes of transactions and data
  • Cloud-based infrastructure ensures reliability
  • Regular updates and new features

docs.title: Integration Ecosystem
docs.text:
Connect HelloHost with the tools you already use:

  • Payment Processing - Mollie for accepting payments
  • Domain Registrars - OXXA and Versio
  • Hosting Panels - cPanel and DirectAdmin
  • Email Delivery - Custom SMTP, Gmail, or Postmark
  • File Storage - Amazon S3 for secure, scalable storage
  • Translations - DeepL for high-quality translations

docs.title: Automation Benefits
docs.text:
HelloHost automates repetitive tasks so you can focus on growing your business:

  • Automated Invoicing - Generate and send invoices automatically
  • Payment Collection - Collect recurring payments without manual intervention
  • Service Provisioning - Automatically create hosting accounts and domains
  • Client Notifications - Send branded emails at the right time
  • Renewal Management - Handle subscription renewals automatically
  • Task Scheduling - Create recurring maintenance tasks

docs.title: Support & Reliability
docs.text:
• Regular platform updates with new features
  • Reliable cloud infrastructure with high uptime
  • Comprehensive documentation
  • Responsive support team

docs.title: Getting Started is Easy
docs.text:
1. Sign up for a HelloHost account
  2. Configure your branding and settings
  3. Connect your payment processor
  4. Add your services to the catalog
  5. Import or add your first clients
  6. Start managing your hosting business efficiently!

See our Getting Started guide for detailed setup instructions.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: Before using HelloHost there are several options that can be configured. You can find these options by hovering over your account and selecting the Settings link.

docs.title: General
docs.text: Here you can configure your brand colors, logo's and the languages that will be available to you and your users.

docs.title: Branding
docs.text:
• Brand Colors - Set your primary and secondary brand colors
  • Logo - Upload your company logo for emails and invoices
  • Company Name - Display name for your organization

docs.title: Languages
docs.text:
• Available Languages - Select which languages to enable for your platform
  • Supported Languages:
  • English (en)
  • German (de)
  • Dutch (nl)
  • Ukrainian (uk)
  • Default Language - Set the default language for new users

docs.title: Accounts
docs.text: Security and user access settings to allow users to create their own account.

docs.title: Registration Settings
docs.text:
• Allow Registration - Enable/disable public account registration
  • Email Verification - Require email verification for new accounts
  • Default Permissions - Set default permissions for new user accounts

docs.title: Security Settings
docs.text:
• Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) - Enable 2FA requirements for users
  • Password Requirements - Configure password complexity rules
  • Session Timeout - Set automatic logout duration
  • Login Attempts - Configure failed login attempt limits

docs.title: Mail
docs.text: Configure an SMTP email account to send personalized email. If you do not configure this section all email will be sent from {brandname}@hellohost.nl and might not be delivered correctly. You will need SMTP credentials in most cases. Certain providers require their own way of handling logins.

docs.title: SMTP Configuration
docs.text:
• SMTP Host - Your mail server hostname
  • SMTP Port - Usually 587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL)
  • SMTP Username - Your email account username
  • SMTP Password - Your email account password
  • From Address - The email address that emails will be sent from
  • From Name - The name that will appear as the sender

docs.title: Gmail
docs.text:
Information to configure Google Gmail can be found here: https://support.google.com/mail/answer/185833?hl=en

Quick Setup: * Host: smtp.gmail.com * Port: 587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL) * You'll need to create an App Password in your Google Account settings

docs.title: Postmark
docs.text:
For reliable transactional email delivery, HelloHost supports Postmark integration.

More information: https://postmarkapp.com

Configuration: * Obtain your Postmark API token from your account * Configure the token in your mail settings * Enjoy high deliverability rates and detailed email tracking

docs.title: Other SMTP Providers
docs.text: HelloHost is compatible with any standard SMTP provider including: * Microsoft 365 / Outlook * SendGrid * Mailgun * Amazon SES * Custom SMTP servers

docs.title: Invoices
docs.text: Basic settings to customize your invoicing logic and basic tax information.

docs.title: Invoice Settings
docs.text:
• Invoice Prefix - Custom prefix for invoice numbers (e.g., "INV-")
  • Starting Number - First invoice number to use
  • Due Date - Default payment due date (e.g., 14 days)
  • Footer Text - Custom text for invoice footer
  • Terms & Conditions - Add terms and conditions to invoices

docs.title: Tax Configuration
docs.text:
• Default Tax Rate - Set your standard VAT/tax percentage
  • Tax Number - Your company VAT/tax identification number
  • EU VAT Validation - Enable automatic EU VAT number validation
  • Reverse Charge - Configure reverse charge mechanism for B2B transactions
  • Tax-Exempt Clients - Mark specific clients as tax-exempt

docs.title: Currency Settings
docs.text:
• Default Currency - Primary currency for your organization
  • Supported Currencies - Enable multiple currencies for international clients
  • Exchange Rates - Configure or update currency exchange rates

docs.title: Payments
docs.text: Configure payment processing to accept online payments from clients.

docs.title: Mollie Configuration
docs.text:
• Mollie API Key - Your Mollie API key from the Mollie dashboard
  • Test Mode - Enable test mode for development and testing
  • Webhook URL - Automatically configured webhook for payment updates

More information: https://www.mollie.com

docs.title: Payment Methods
docs.text: Enable/disable specific payment methods: * iDEAL (Netherlands) * Credit Card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) * SEPA Direct Debit * PayPal * Bancontact (Belgium) * Sofort (Europe) * Other Mollie-supported methods

docs.title: Direct Debit
docs.text:
• SEPA Mandates - Enable SEPA direct debit mandates
  • Mandate Management - View and manage client mandates
  • Automatic Collection - Configure automatic payment collection

docs.title: Permissions & Roles
docs.text: Configure role-based access control for your team members.

docs.title: User Roles
docs.text:
• Super Admin - Full system access (cannot be restricted)
  • Admin - Administrative access with configurable permissions
  • Employee - Limited access based on assigned permissions
  • Client - Customer portal access only

docs.title: Configurable Permissions
docs.text:
Client Management: * View all clients * Create/edit clients * Delete clients * Manage subscriptions * Access password memos

Financial Management: * View invoices and payments * Create/edit invoices * Process payments and refunds * Manage orders * View financial statistics

Task Management: * View all tasks * Create/edit tasks * Assign tasks * Review completed tasks * Access recurring tasks

Service Management: * View services * Create/edit services * Manage pricing * Archive services

System Management: * System settings * User management * Role configuration * Integration settings

docs.title: Activity Logging
docs.text: HelloHost automatically tracks user actions for security and audit purposes.

docs.title: Logged Activities
docs.text:
• User authentication events
  • Client record changes
  • Invoice creation and modifications
  • Payment transactions
  • Subscription changes
  • Task updates
  • Setting modifications
  • Permission changes

docs.title: Activity Log Settings
docs.text:
• Retention Period - How long to keep activity logs
  • Log Detail Level - Configure verbosity of logging
  • User Access - Control who can view activity logs

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text: Configure which notifications are sent to clients and team members.

docs.title: Client Notifications
docs.text:
• New Invoice - Notify clients when invoices are created
  • Invoice Reminder - Send reminders for unpaid invoices
  • Payment Confirmation - Confirm successful payments
  • Order Updates - Notify about order status changes
  • Subscription Renewals - Alert before subscription renewals
  • Domain Notifications - Registration, transfer, and expiration alerts
  • Task Updates - Notify clients of public task updates

docs.title: Team Notifications
docs.text:
• New Orders - Alert team when orders are placed
  • Payment Failures - Notify of failed payment attempts
  • Task Assignments - Notify when tasks are assigned
  • System Alerts - Critical system notifications

docs.title: Notification Timing
docs.text:
• Reminder Schedule - Configure when to send invoice reminders
  • Renewal Notices - Set advance notice for subscription renewals
  • Batch Processing - Configure notification batch sending times

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text: Configure third-party service integrations. See the Connectors section for detailed information.

docs.title: Available Integrations
docs.text:
• Payment Providers - Mollie for payment processing
  • Domain Registrars - OXXA, Versio
  • Hosting Servers - cPanel, DirectAdmin
  • Error Tracking - Sentry for error monitoring
  • File Storage - Amazon S3
  • Email Delivery - Postmark
  • Translations - DeepL
  • Performance - Google Lighthouse (via Solutionsio)

docs.title: Multi-tenancy
docs.text:
• Tenant Domain - Configure your tenant's custom domain
  • Database Connection - Tenant-specific database settings (automatic)
  • Storage Path - Tenant file storage configuration

docs.title: Performance
docs.text:
• Cache Configuration - Redis caching settings
  • Queue Workers - Background job processing
  • Session Management - Session driver and lifetime

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
• Debug Mode - Enable detailed error messages (development only)
  • Test Mode - Enable test mode for integrations
  • API Access - Generate API tokens for external integrations

docs.title: Backup & Maintenance
docs.text:
• Automated Backups - Schedule regular database backups
  • Maintenance Mode - Enable maintenance mode for updates
  • Data Export - Export client data and reports

docs.title: Connectors
docs.text: Several components of HelloHost are provided with the help of third party connections. API keys and configuration are required here.

docs.title: Payments
docs.text:
Currently the only supported payment provider for HelloHost is Mollie. If you want to allow users to pay invoices directly, an account here will be required.

HelloHost supports payment links to any of your activated payment methods and direct debit payments with SEPA transfers or credit cards.

More information about Mollie can be found here: https://www.mollie.com

docs.title: Mollie Setup
docs.text:
1. Create an account at Mollie.com
  2. Complete the onboarding process and verify your business
  3. Navigate to Developers > API Keys in your Mollie dashboard
  4. Copy your API key (Live or Test)
  5. Enter the API key in HelloHost Settings > Payments

docs.title: Supported Payment Methods
docs.text:
• iDEAL - Popular in the Netherlands
  • Credit Card - Visa, Mastercard, American Express
  • SEPA Direct Debit - Automated recurring payments
  • PayPal - International payments
  • Bancontact - Popular in Belgium
  • Sofort - European bank transfers
  • Apple Pay - Mobile payments
  • Google Pay - Mobile payments
  • And many more supported by Mollie

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Payment Links - Generate payment links for invoices
  • Subscription Billing - Automated recurring payments via Laravel Cashier
  • Refunds - Process full and partial refunds
  • Mandates - SEPA direct debit mandate management
  • Webhooks - Real-time payment status updates
  • Multi-currency - Support for multiple currencies

docs.title: Domain Registrars
docs.text: HelloHost supports several domain registrars. We recommend using OXXA for the best experience.

docs.title: OXXA
docs.text:
OXXA provides a big selection of domain TLDs available for direct registration. An account on their platform is required to use the connection.

More information about OXXA can be found here: https://www.oxxa.com/

Supported features:

  • Domain listing - View all registered domains
  • Domain registration - Register new domains
  • Domain transfer - Transfer domains from other registrars
  • DNS management - Full DNS zone editing (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, etc.)
  • Domain locking - Lock/unlock domains
  • Auth codes - Request EPP/auth codes for transfers
  • Auto-renewal management - Enable/disable auto-renewal
  • Contact management - Update domain contacts
  • WHOIS privacy - Enable WHOIS privacy protection

Setup:

  1. Create a reseller account at OXXA
  2. Obtain your API credentials from the OXXA dashboard
  3. Enter the API credentials in HelloHost Settings > Domain Registrars
  4. Test the connection and start managing domains

docs.title: Versio
docs.text:
We provide limited support for Versio. An account on their platform is required to use the connection.

More information: https://www.versio.nl/

Supported features:

  • Domain listing - View registered domains
  • Auto-renewal management - Enable/disable auto-renewal

Setup:

  1. Create a reseller account at Versio
  2. Obtain API credentials
  3. Configure in HelloHost Settings > Domain Registrars

Note: Versio integration has limited functionality compared to OXXA. For full domain management features, we recommend using OXXA.

docs.title: Hosting Servers
docs.text: We provide support for several of the more common hosting management platforms. This feature is currently under development and being extended. In order to use these connections you will either need a server or reseller account, and an API key to connect the servers directly.

docs.title: cPanel
docs.text:
cPanel is one of the most popular web hosting control panels.

More information: https://cpanel.net/

Supported features:

  • Create accounts - Automatically provision hosting accounts
  • Delete accounts - Remove hosting accounts
  • Account management - Basic account operations

Setup:

  1. Ensure you have WHM (Web Host Manager) access
  2. Generate an API token in WHM
  3. Add server connection in HelloHost Settings > Hosting Servers
  4. Configure cPanel as the server type
  5. Enter server hostname and API credentials

Requirements: * WHM root access or reseller account * API token authentication enabled * HTTPS access to WHM API

docs.title: DirectAdmin
docs.text:
DirectAdmin is a lightweight and fast web hosting control panel.

More information: https://www.directadmin.com/

Supported features:

  • Create accounts - Automatically provision hosting accounts
  • Delete accounts - Remove hosting accounts

Setup:

  1. Ensure you have DirectAdmin admin or reseller access
  2. Generate API credentials
  3. Add server connection in HelloHost Settings > Hosting Servers
  4. Configure DirectAdmin as the server type
  5. Enter server details and credentials

Requirements: * Admin or reseller level access * API access enabled * HTTPS access to DirectAdmin

docs.title: Amazon S3
docs.text:
HelloHost supports Amazon S3 for scalable and reliable file storage.

More information: https://aws.amazon.com/s3/

Features:

  • Scalable Storage - Unlimited storage capacity
  • High Availability - 99.99% uptime SLA
  • Secure - Encrypted at rest and in transit
  • Cost-effective - Pay only for what you use
  • Multi-region - Store files close to your users

Supported File Types:

  • Client attachments
  • Invoice PDFs
  • Service images
  • Task attachments
  • Backups

Setup:

  1. Create an AWS account
  2. Create an S3 bucket in your preferred region
  3. Create an IAM user with S3 access
  4. Generate access keys for the IAM user
  5. Configure S3 credentials in HelloHost environment settings
  6. Set bucket name and region

Required Permissions:

  • s3:PutObject - Upload files
  • s3:GetObject - Download files
  • s3:DeleteObject - Delete files
  • s3:ListBucket - List bucket contents

docs.title: Postmark
docs.text:
For reliable transactional email delivery, HelloHost integrates with Postmark.

More information: https://postmarkapp.com/

Features:

  • High Deliverability - Optimized for transactional emails
  • Fast Delivery - Emails delivered in seconds
  • Detailed Analytics - Open rates, bounce tracking, spam complaints
  • Email Templates - Use Postmark's template system
  • Webhook Support - Real-time delivery notifications

Supported Email Types:

  • Invoice notifications
  • Payment confirmations
  • Order notifications
  • Task updates
  • Account activation emails
  • Password resets
  • Custom notifications

Setup:

  1. Create a Postmark account
  2. Create a server in Postmark
  3. Verify your sending domain
  4. Copy your Server API Token
  5. Configure in HelloHost Settings > Mail
  6. Select Postmark as your mail driver

docs.title: DeepL
docs.text:
HelloHost integrates with DeepL for high-quality automated translations in the ticket workflow.

More information: https://www.deepl.com/

Setup:

  1. Create a DeepL API account
  2. Subscribe to a plan (Free or Pro)
  3. Copy your API authentication key
  4. Configure in HelloHost environment settings
  5. Use translation features in content management

docs.title: Google Lighthouse
docs.text:
HelloHost integrates with Google Lighthouse for website performance monitoring through the Solutionsio service.

Features:

  • Performance Scores - Overall website performance metrics
  • Desktop & Mobile - Separate scores for different devices
  • Historical Tracking - Track performance changes over time
  • Multiple Metrics:
  • Performance
  • Accessibility
  • Best Practices
  • SEO
  • Automated Syncing - Regular performance data updates

Use Cases:

  • Monitor client website performance
  • Track improvements after optimizations
  • Report on hosting service quality
  • Identify performance issues proactively

Setup:

  1. Contact solutions.io for API access
  2. Obtain API credentials
  3. Configure in HelloHost settings
  4. Add PageSpeed reports for client websites
  5. Reports will sync automatically

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
All connector configurations can be managed in the HelloHost settings panel:

  1. Log in to your HelloHost admin account
  2. Navigate to Settings from the account menu
  3. Select the appropriate section (Payments, Domain Registrars, Hosting Servers, etc.)
  4. Enter your API credentials and configuration
  5. Test the connection to verify setup
  6. Save and activate the integration

docs.title: Connection Issues
docs.text:
If you experience connection problems:

  • Verify API credentials - Ensure keys are copied correctly
  • Check API permissions - Verify your account has necessary permissions
  • Test API endpoint - Confirm the service is accessible from your server
  • Review firewall rules - Ensure outbound connections are allowed
  • Check service status - Verify the third-party service is operational

docs.title: API Limits
docs.text:
Most services have API rate limits:

  • Mollie - Generous limits for most operations
  • OXXA - Rate limits vary by operation type
  • Versio - Conservative rate limits
  • DeepL - Character limits based on subscription

Monitor your usage to avoid hitting limits. HelloHost will handle rate limiting gracefully and queue operations when necessary.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Welcome to HelloHost! This guide will help you get started with the platform.

docs.title: Creating Your Account
docs.text:
1. Visit hellohost.nl
  2. Click "Sign Up" or "Get Started"
  3. Fill in your organization details:
  4. Company name
  5. Your name and email
  6. Choose a password
  7. Verify your email address by clicking the link in the confirmation email
  8. Complete the initial setup wizard

docs.title: Initial Setup
docs.text: After creating your account, you'll want to configure a few essential settings to get the most out of HelloHost.

docs.title: Step 1: Configure Your Branding
docs.text:
Navigate to Settings > General:

  • Upload your logo - This will appear on invoices and emails to clients
  • Set brand colors - Choose colors that match your company identity
  • Select languages - Enable the languages you and your clients will use
  • Set company details - Add your business name and contact information

docs.title: Step 2: Setup Email
docs.text:
Navigate to Settings > Mail:

Professional emails from your own domain help build trust with clients.

Option 1: Use Gmail * Host: smtp.gmail.com * Port: 587 * Create an App Password in your Google Account * Enter your email and app password

Option 2: Use Your Email Provider * Get SMTP details from your email provider * Enter host, port, username, and password * Set your "From" name and email address

Option 3: Use Postmark (Recommended for high volume) * Sign up at Postmark * Get your API token * Configure in HelloHost settings

Send a test email to make sure everything works!

docs.title: Step 3: Configure Invoicing
docs.text:
Navigate to Settings > Invoices:

  • Invoice prefix - e.g., "INV-" for invoice numbers like INV-001
  • Starting number - Choose your first invoice number
  • Payment terms - Set how many days clients have to pay (e.g., 14 days)
  • Tax rate - Set your VAT/tax percentage
  • Company details - Add your business registration and VAT number
  • Footer text - Add payment instructions or terms

docs.title: Step 4: Setup Payment Processing (Optional but Recommended)
docs.text:
To accept online payments from clients:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Payments
  2. Sign up for Mollie at mollie.com if you don't have an account
  3. Complete Mollie's onboarding and verification process
  4. Copy your API key from Mollie dashboard
  5. Enter the API key in HelloHost
  6. Enable your preferred payment methods (iDEAL, Credit Card, etc.)
  7. Test with a small payment

With payment processing enabled, clients can pay invoices online instantly!

docs.title: Adding Your First Client
docs.text:
1. Click Clients in the main menu
  2. Click the Add Client button
  3. Fill in the client information:
  4. Basic Info: First name, last name, company name
  5. Contact: Email addresses for notifications and invoices, phone number
  6. Address: Complete billing address
  7. Preferences: Preferred language and currency
  8. Click Save

Your client now has an account and can access their portal!

docs.title: Creating Your Service Catalog
docs.text:
Before you can add subscriptions, you need to create services that you offer.

  1. Navigate to Services
  2. Click Add Service
  3. Fill in the service details:

Basic Information: * Name - e.g., "Shared Hosting - Basic" * Description - What's included in this service * Category - Optional: group services into categories

Pricing: * Price - Monthly cost * Billing Interval - How often to bill (1 month, 3 months, 12 months, etc.)

Service Type: * Domain - For domain registration services * Hosting - For web hosting packages * Custom - For anything else (support, SSL, email, etc.)

Optional Settings: * Featured - Mark as a featured service for clients * Renewal notification - Send notification before renewal * Add an image - Make it look professional

  1. Click Save

Repeat this for all services you want to offer.

docs.title: Adding a Subscription for a Client
docs.text:
Now that you have clients and services, let's add a subscription:

  1. Open a client's profile
  2. Go to the Subscriptions tab
  3. Click Add Subscription
  4. Select a service from your catalog
  5. Configure the subscription:
  6. Start date - When the subscription begins
  7. Custom price - Override the default price if needed
  8. Auto-renewal - Enable automatic renewal (recommended)
  9. Description - Add specific details for this client
  10. Click Save

HelloHost will now automatically: * Generate invoices based on the billing cycle * Send invoice notifications to the client * Track renewals and send reminders

docs.title: Creating and Sending an Invoice
docs.text:
Invoices are usually generated automatically from subscriptions, but you can also create manual invoices:

  1. Open a client's profile
  2. Go to the Invoices tab
  3. Click Create Invoice
  4. Add invoice lines:
  5. Description (e.g., "One-time setup fee")
  6. Quantity
  7. Unit price
  8. Tax rate (automatically filled from settings)
  9. Review the total
  10. Click Save & Send

The client receives an email with: * Professional PDF invoice * Direct payment link (if Mollie is configured) * Payment instructions

docs.title: Creating a Task
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Tasks
  2. Click Add Task
  3. Fill in:
  4. Title - Brief description
  5. Description - Full details
  6. Client - Link to client (optional)
  7. Status - Open, In Progress, Completed
  8. Priority - Low, Normal, High, Urgent
  9. Due date - When it needs to be done
  10. Assign to - Team member responsible
  11. Public - If enabled, client can see the task
  12. Click Save

docs.title: Converting Tasks to Invoices
docs.text:
Did billable work? Convert it to an invoice:

  1. Open a completed task
  2. Track the time spent
  3. Click Add to Invoice
  4. Select the client and invoice (or create new)
  5. The task work is added as an invoice line

docs.title: Connecting Domain Registrars (Optional)
docs.text: To automate domain registration and management:

docs.title: Using OXXA (Recommended)
docs.text:
1. Sign up for a reseller account at OXXA
  2. Get your API credentials from OXXA dashboard
  3. In HelloHost: Settings > Domain Registrars
  4. Click Add Registrar
  5. Select OXXA and enter credentials
  6. Test connection

Now you can: * Register domains directly from HelloHost * Manage DNS zones * Handle domain transfers * Auto-renew domains

docs.title: Using Versio
docs.text: Similar process for Versio with limited functionality (domain listing and auto-renewal only).

docs.title: Connecting Hosting Servers (Optional)
docs.text: To automate hosting account creation:

docs.title: Using cPanel
docs.text:
1. Ensure you have WHM access
  2. Generate an API token in WHM
  3. In HelloHost: Settings > Hosting Servers
  4. Add your server with hostname and API token
  5. Test connection

docs.title: Using DirectAdmin
docs.text:
Similar process with DirectAdmin admin credentials.

Now when you create hosting subscriptions, HelloHost can automatically create the hosting accounts!

docs.title: Inviting Team Members
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Settings > Users
  2. Click Add User
  3. Enter their email and name
  4. Assign a role:
  5. Admin - Full access
  6. Employee - Limited access based on permissions
  7. Configure specific permissions:
  8. Can view/edit clients
  9. Can manage invoices
  10. Can process payments
  11. Can manage tasks
  12. Send invitation

They'll receive an email to set up their account.

docs.title: Customizing Client Notifications
docs.text:
Control which emails clients receive:

Settings > Notifications:

  • New Invoice - When invoices are created
  • Invoice Reminder - For overdue invoices
  • Payment Confirmation - After successful payment
  • Order Updates - Order status changes
  • Renewal Reminders - Before subscription renewals
  • Task Updates - For public tasks

Customize timing and frequency to match your preferences.

docs.title: Using Labels to Organize Clients
docs.text:
Keep clients organized with labels:

  1. Navigate to Clients > Labels
  2. Create labels like:
  3. "VIP Customer"
  4. "Payment Issues"
  5. "Monthly Plan"
  6. "Yearly Plan"
  7. Assign colors to labels
  8. Tag clients with labels
  9. Filter clients by label

docs.title: Start Simple
docs.text:
• Add a few clients first
  • Create 2-3 basic services
  • Get comfortable with the interface
  • Expand from there

docs.title: Automate When Ready
docs.text:
• Connect payment processing to reduce manual work
  • Use auto-renewal for subscriptions
  • Set up recurring tasks for regular maintenance
  • Connect domain registrars and hosting servers

docs.title: Keep Clients Informed
docs.text:
• Enable appropriate notifications
  • Add clear descriptions to services
  • Use the public task feature for transparency
  • Send professional branded invoices

docs.title: Use the Dashboard
docs.text:
• Check revenue statistics regularly
  • Monitor overdue invoices
  • Review upcoming renewals
  • Track team performance

docs.title: Common Questions
docs.text:
Q: Can I import existing clients? A: You can manually add clients one by one, or contact support for bulk import assistance.

Q: What if I need a service type not in the catalog? A: Use the "Custom Service" type - it works for any billable item.

Q: Can clients see their subscription history? A: Yes! They have full access to their portal with invoices, subscriptions, and services.

Q: How do I handle one-time payments? A: Create a manual invoice instead of a subscription.

Q: Can I customize invoice templates? A: Branding (logo, colors) is customizable. Contact support for advanced customization.

Q: What happens if a payment fails? A: The client receives a notification, and you're alerted in the dashboard.
